name: streaming-radar
description: Search and read the Streaming Radar newsletter archive, list the experts it quotes, and pull sourced chart data on streaming markets.

interface.longDescription: Search and read the Streaming Radar newsletter archive, list the experts it quotes, and pull sourced data and chart configurations on vertical drama, streaming in Africa, piracy, sports streaming and the creator economy. Check what the database covers before you ask. Country and company briefs and the detailed datapoints open for the reports your account is entitled to. Also: read the vertical drama booklet, ask the Streaming Radar editors a question by email, suggest a data point or a source for moderation, and set your digest preferences. Each figure carries its source and date. Intended for streaming and media professionals. Limits: the tools return published and curated material only and give no investment advice. They message no one except in two cases you trigger yourself: a question to a Streaming Radar editor, and the digest email you switch on for your own address.
capabilities: Suggest data and sources for review
defaultPrompt: What did Streaming Radar publish about vertical drama?
Show the expert leaderboard chart data.
Which experts does the newsletter quote most?

positive.prompt: What did Streaming Radar publish about vertical drama?
positive.expected_behavior: Return a list of published editions with title, date and link.

positive.prompt: Open the most recent edition on that topic.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the full text of the edition with its cited sources.

positive.description: List content published since a date
positive.expected_behavior: Return the editions published after that date.

positive.prompt: Which experts does the newsletter quote most?
positive.expected_behavior: Return a list of experts without any contact address.

positive.prompt: Does the database cover streaming in Africa?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the number of datapoints by report, without the values themselves.

negative.prompt: Send an email to all newsletter subscribers.
Give me the email addresses of the experts you quote.
Tell me which stock to buy in streaming.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: newsletter search and reading, quoted experts, sourced chart data, data coverage check.

Vérifiez ce que la base couvre avant de poser votre question. Chaque chiffre porte sa source et sa date. Destiné aux professionnels du streaming et des médias.
